title: REVIEW_EVIDENCE_CONTRACT_V1 — review evidence pack
description: Versioned machine contract for a Review Evidence pack. The single semantic detail owner is references/review-evidence.md; this file is its mechanical form. Consumed by scripts/review_evidence.py (validate/collect) and reproduced in placeholder form by templates/review-evidence.json. Keyword subset deliberately limited to the operators scripts/review_evidence.py implements; an unknown operator is rejected rather than ignored.

schemaVersion.description: Supported value domain {1}. An unknown value is rejected as EVIDENCE_VERSION_UNKNOWN; no migration is ever guessed.

repo.description: Target repository remote or owner/repo. A value that is not the target repository is rejected as EVIDENCE_SUBJECT_MISMATCH.

baseSha.description: Full 40-hex candidate base SHA. Unparseable or stale versus the reviewed base is rejected.

candidateSha.description: Full 40-hex SHA of the candidate under review. A value that is not the candidate under review is rejected as EVIDENCE_STALE_SUBJECT.

authorityRefs.description: Versioned contract references the pack is produced under. Absent content makes the evidence insufficient; it is never a structural substitute for anything else.

commandRef.description: A REFERENCE to what was run, for traceability only. It is never an execution authority: no consumer of this contract runs it.

status.description: CHECK_STATUS: the result of ONE mechanical check, closed set. This is deliberately NOT CI_STATUS and must never be used as a CI state machine.

location.description: Evidence declaration only. It is neither a network nor a filesystem authority; the retrieval boundary is not decided by this contract.

checkedSha.description: The SHA the CI run actually checked; empty means no CI observation was recorded. Whether it binds to the reviewed candidate is a consumption rule, not a shape rule.

originalState.description: CI_STATUS: the existing seven-value set adopted by reference from references/git-ci-integration.md section 3. It is neither replaced nor extended here, and no second CI status machine may be declared.

mode.description: Machine spelling of the three grounding modes owned by references/codegraph-grounding.md section 2.1 (A BASE + DIFF / B LANE_INDEX / C UNAVAILABLE). The mode semantics stay owned there; this field only spells them so the value is decidable.

coverage.description: Coverage statement for the chosen mode, in the vocabulary of the canonical grounding reference.

seams.description: seams.applicability is isomorphic with REACHABILITY_APPLICABILITY (REQ-W1-01): REQUIRED | N/A, and N/A requires a reason plus an acceptance reference.

sourceEvidence.description: Which earlier evidence is being reused.

validFor.description: The range in which the reuse claim as a whole is asserted to still hold.

dependencies.description: The REQ-W2-04(e) dependency analysis. Declared once, here, as the closed structure above; a free-text string is not a legal value. The behavioural lifecycle (reuse legality, per-type validity, targeted invalidation) is consumed by P1-T08 and is not implemented by this contract.

invalidation.description: What change invalidates this reuse claim at the claim level.

unverified.description: Explicit list of what this pack has NOT verified. The key must be present: omitting it is structurally invalid, while an explicit empty array is the legal statement of 'nothing unverified'.

STRUCTURALLY_VALID.description: Structural axis, closed set. NO means the pack does not enter consumption (REJECT). What a consumer does with each value is not decided here.

SOURCE_VERIFICATION_STATE.description: Source axis, closed set, independent of the sufficiency axis. INVALID means the source or content is itself mechanically wrong (SHA mismatch, digest mismatch, invalid source identity, path violation). TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE means the source could not currently be reached and is NOT invalidated; folding it into INVALID is illegal.

EVIDENCE_SUFFICIENCY.description: Sufficiency axis, closed set, independent of the source axis. INSUFFICIENT belongs to this axis only and is never a SOURCE_VERIFICATION_STATE value. VERIFIED together with INSUFFICIENT is a legal, non-contradictory pair.

semanticScopeStatus.description: Field name declared here only. Its value comes from reviewer authority (REQ-W2-05) and is not derivable from producer observation; who may write it and what a consumer may derive from it is not decided by this contract. null means no reviewer value has been written.

reviewerDecisionRefs.description: Field name declared here only. It keeps reviewer decisions in fields separate from machine facts (REQ-W2-06); who may write it and what a consumer may derive from it is not decided by this contract. The machine pack never self-approves a reviewer verdict.

WHAT.description: What the dependency is (shared schema / shared dependency / entry topology / toolchain / authority profile).

IDENTITY_VERSION_OR_DIGEST.description: Identity of that dependency: at least one of a version or a content digest.

VALID_FOR.description: The range in which this dependency is still valid for the reused evidence.

INVALIDATED_BY.description: What change invalidates it (corresponds to the invalidation trigger list).

VERIFICATION_STATE.description: Closed value domain. UNKNOWN means the dependency was not verified, and the reuse of the evidence is therefore not permitted; the rule that consumes this value belongs to P1-T08.
